lobby_nan.text: Come in, duck, sit down. You'll have some lobby. No, you will. Everyone has lobby.
Arnold Bennett grew up round here, you know. He wrote about women like my nan. Hard work, chapel on Sunday, a pot of something on the hob.

then.text: Here, take some for the road. And a spoon. Bring the spoon back.

else.text: You had your lobby today. Come back tomorrow, I'll do another pan.
